summary: Timeboxed audit sample provisioning with privacy safeguards for regulatory evidence
description: Request from Compliance to produce a small, time-limited sample of user sessions and matching request/response traces to support a regulatory audit by CuraHealth. Samples must be minimized, PII redacted or tokenized, and access granted only to named auditors via a temporary access token. This ticket coordinates technical extraction, privacy review, and on-call access controls.
impact: No platform degradation expected. Customer CuraHealth is under a regulatory evidence request window; delay in providing evidence may escalate to legal and could affect contract timelines.
reason_for_request: Regulatory auditor asked for representative session traces covering a payment authorization flow and associated inference outputs for three customer accounts during 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-05.
requested_items: Up to 25 anonymized session traces matching provided user IDs and API keys
Associated request headers (redacted for auth tokens)
Model input/output snippets with PII redacted/tokenized
A short manifest describing redaction decisions and extraction script hashes
access_controls: Temporary signed S3 bundle with pre-signed URL expiring in 72 hours + IP allowlist for auditor CIDRs; access provisioned to external audit role via AWS STS with MFA enforced. No console login provided.
retention_plan: Extract stored in controlled bucket with object lifecycle to delete after 7 days automatically. Audit copy retained for internal review for 30 days only if Data Governance approves; otherwise deleted after 7 days.
risk_assessment: Low-to-moderate risk if minimization is followed. Main risks: inadvertent PII leakage from un-redacted inference outputs and over-provisioned access. Mitigations: automated redaction script, skip-list for high-risk fields, reviewer sign-off required before upload.
steps_to_obtain: 1) Compliance provides list of account IDs + time window. 2) Oncall runs extraction script (tools/extract_session_samples.py) in prod read-only role with query filters. 3) Script produces raw bundle + redaction run. 4) Privacy team reviews redacted bundle and approves. 5) SRE uploads to pre-signed S3 and shares URL with auditor. 6) Log all actions and commit extraction script artifact to internal repo with traceable hash.
repro_steps: N/A — this is a one-off evidence extraction. To validate process, run extraction pipeline against staging mirror and verify redaction output meets policy.

investigation_notes: Initial query returned 42 candidate sessions; applied minimization heuristics to choose 25 representative sessions (payment, login, message_flow)
Redaction script replaced free-text PII with stable tokens; kept token mapping in ephemeral vault accessible only to Privacy reviewers
No KV-cache dumps required; only request/response pairs and model logits summary produced
Staging dry-run produced one case where user-supplied filenames contained phone-like strings; added additional regex to redaction skip-list
